note: Cells: intact white blood cells (lymphocytes, monocytes, and granulocytes captured as one envelope) — broad WBC blob in the middle of the FSC × SSC plane spanning the lymphocyte (low FSC/SSC), monocyte (mid), and granulocyte (high SSC) clusters as a single inclusive envelope. The lower-left debris corner and a thin upper saturation band at the SSC-A axis max are excluded.
tips: Forward/side scatter cleanup to isolate intact white blood cells. Cells: events within a broad WBC scatter envelope spanning the lymphocyte (FSC-low / SSC-low), monocyte (FSC-mid / SSC-mid), and granulocyte (FSC-mid-to-high / SSC-high) clusters as a single polygon. Excluded: lower-left debris (RBC fragments, platelets, dead-cell remnants, free fluorochrome / dye aggregates near the SSC baseline) and upper-right aggregates (cell clumps and large doublets that pre-empt the dedicated singlet gates at Steps 3–4). The three WBC clusters often touch on the FSC × SSC plane, so the gate is drawn as one inclusive envelope.
